payload.claim: The Context section's cited line numbers (e.g. saffron/intake.py:557-601 and :580-581 for discover_specs, :244 for Spec.depends_on; saffron/cell/session.py:2352 and :3590-3594; saffron/phases/review.py:717-765; saffron/cli.py:350-351) are stale at this snapshot (base 31c0454). The spec itself says these were read at f0ffaad6, but SA-0399, SA-0400 and their review commits landed afterward and touched exactly those files, shifting the real line numbers by a handful of lines in each case (e.g. discover_specs is actually defined at line 560 with raises at 583/585; task_dir = out_dir / spec.spec_id is actually at line 2365; the wrong-versions.json write is actually at line 3605; Spec.depends_on is actually at line 247; out_dir's default is actually at lines 351-352). The underlying behavioral claims remain true at this snapshot; only the line pointers are off, and no acceptance criterion, witness, or verbatim instruction depends on these specific numbers, so this does not change what a cell would build.
